latest.title: Shockable rhythms decay fast in untreated arrest
latest.finding: Median initial shockable rhythm prevalence 33.5% in unselected cohorts; increasing time-to-defibrillation was consistently associated with falling shockable-rhythm prevalence, lower defibrillation success, less ROSC and worse survival

latest.title: Simulated prehospital eCPR shows large time savings
latest.finding: Call-to-decision 18 (SD 5) vs 49 minutes; estimated call-to-ECMO-flow shorter in the prehospital arm, assuming 20 minutes of on-scene cannulation

latest.title: Heat and ozone together raise cardiac arrest risk
latest.finding: Above a ~60 ppb ozone threshold, each 10 ppb rise at extreme heat (99th percentile temperature) was associated with RR 1.04 (95% CI 1.03–1.05), with synergistic interaction on both additive and multiplicative scales

latest.title: Recorded burn cooling varied by family citizenship
latest.finding: Cooling recorded for 79.1% of Italian vs 61.2% of non-Italian records (difference −17.8 pp, 95% CI −28.0 to −7.9); adjusted odds ratios 2.04 for no first aid and 3.15 for remedies in non-Italian records
